content: On it. Plan: honest framing first — Jane Street/Citadel edges are market-making, latency and ETF/index arbitrage that need colocation, inventory and sub-tick costs a micro-futures account can't access; what *is* transferable is the strategy class, so I'll use the QuantConnect research skills to mine the public QuantConnect/LEAN strategy library and institutional-style families we have NOT tested (e.g. cross-asset carry/basis, term-structure/roll signals, volatility-risk-premium timing, index-rebalance/close-auction flows, statistical arbitrage frameworks) for anything buildable on MNQ/MES with our data, pre-register and run each at micro costs, and report. No spend without quoting.
